precepts.text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts of lasciviousness, lust, adultery, and fornication, and let him return unto the Lord, and he will abundantly pardon, if sincere and not doing evil on the back end thinking nobody sees. The Lord knows the heartbeat of a raven and you think he does not see you. My thoughts are not your thoughts; as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways. Looking down from heaven he sees what we cannot; our only vantage point is our immediate circumference. Likewise a department manager sees his space, and the leadership sees the interactions between all the departments, and the man on the tower sees the danger and sounds the trumpet for the people behind him. As the rain returns not void, everything the Lord sends accomplishes his purpose; so when we say leave the sister alone, there is a reason you do not see until it is revealed in judgment, after you have already laid with the dude. Follow the steps, betrothal and all, and the council can bless the wedding and counsel the trouble in the flesh; say to hell with it and you are saying we have nothing to do with you.
precepts.point: The vision is yet for an appointed time; at the end it shall speak, and not lie; though it tarry, wait for it, because it will surely come. Habakkuk, Ezra, the disciples, everyone asked when; do not worry, it is coming, so be ready. Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him, Esau; but the just shall live by his faith, by the words of the book of our fathers.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
Habakkuk was told, “the just shall live by his faith”, by the words of the book of our fathers. Isaiah shows what that faith requires of us: “Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.”

Those of us in wickedness must forsake it, and forsake the unrighteous thoughts of lasciviousness, lust, adultery and fornication. Get that thing out of your mind. He will pardon us if we are sincere, not pretending while on the back end doing evil and thinking nobody sees. The Lord understands the heartbeat of a raven, how many times a bird's heart will beat its whole life, and you think he don't see your black ass? You are playing with death.

“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways”. Looking down from heaven on the whole planet, he sees everything we cannot. Our only vantage point is our immediate circumference, and we cannot take that and tell the Lord what to do.

It works the same in the congregation. A manager of a department sees his space; the leadership over all the departments sees the interactions between them, and why something is happening here and not there. Leaders are in front to protect the flock because they see the danger you do not see. The man on the tower sees it coming and sounds the trumpet with a certain sound, so the people know what to prepare for.

“So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please”. As the rain waters the earth and does not return void, everything the Lord sends has a purpose. So when leadership says, brother, leave the sister alone, or sister, leave the brother alone, there is a vantage point you do not see, and if you will not hear it, it gets revealed in judgment after you done laid with the dude. Follow the steps, betrothal and the whole nine, and the council can bless the wedding and counsel the trouble in the flesh. Say to hell with all of it, and you are saying you have nothing to do with us.

precepts.text: His thoughts are not our thoughts, neither are our ways his ways; his thoughts are higher than our thoughts.
precepts.point: The Most High is in control of everything, good and evil alike. Even affliction that comes on his people is his tactic to make them seek him and repent; nothing anybody does can alter the outcome he has already ordained, for he declared the end from the beginning.

note.label: Judges 14: An Occasion Against the Philistines

precepts.why: “his father and his mother knew not that it was of the Lord”. The Lord was moving Samson’s spirit, and the parents did not understand, just as we often question the Most High when we have no idea the depths of his wisdom and what he is really doing. “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.” Who would think the Most High would use a man’s lust after Philistine women as an occasion against the Philistines, to destroy them for oppressing his people? His ways are higher than ours.

precepts.text: The Most High's thoughts and ways are higher than ours, so the reason for such exact preparation belongs to Him.
precepts.point: It has a wall round about, five hundred reeds long and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place. By rehearsing these measurements in such detail, the vision is pointing to the kingdom: the temple will be established again with the same measurements given to King Solomon, done all over again. As for why the Father requires such careful preparation, that is above our pay grade; we are to follow and learn, for His thoughts are not our thoughts.

note.label: Ezekiel 42: The Priests' Chambers and the Separation of the Sanctuary

precepts.why:
The angel measures the whole compass round about, five hundred reeds on the east, five hundred on the north, five hundred on the south, five hundred on the west, about fifty-five hundred feet per side, with a wall round about “to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.” Why does the Father require such careful preparation, rehearsed in such detail? “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.”

That is above our pay grade. The Most High's thoughts and ways are higher than ours, so the reason for such exact preparation belongs to Him. We are to follow and learn.

What the measurements do tell us is where this is pointing: the kingdom. The temple will be established again with the same measurements given to King Solomon, done all over again.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 1 A Visit From The Lord

precepts.why: We go here because Revelation 1:5 said Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. “Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.” The Lord gave Christ for a witness to the people. Christ is a leader and commander of the people. That is some heavy stuff right there.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 3 A Message to The 7 Churches

precepts.why:
This examines what he means when he says I counsel thee to buy of me. “Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat;” Buy and eat what? The Bible, the word of God; that is what he is saying. “yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.” Without money. This truth is not something you can buy. You have to pray to the Lord and he will give it to you, like it says in James 1: he gives wisdom liberally and upbraideth not.

That thou mayest be rich: not that carnal money you have, not the Bitcoin, not the dollars and cents, not the credit cards. He wants you to be rich in understanding his word.

moments.label: Covetous Eyes Will Be Put Out

points: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people: God already gave us an example. Christ is our commander. Commanders are not moved with emotions. Commanders are not easily swayed. Commanders think it through; they are strategic. Commanders are calculated. Commanders have contingencies in place. They understand that one thing creates another; they understand that dominoes fall. They consider the end before they make any moves. It ain't checkers. That's what Christ is for us: a leader and a commander.
Seek ye the Lord while he may be found; call upon him while he is near. Classes like this come out because the Lord is looking for you.

note.label: Covetous Eyes Will Be Put Out

points: As the rain and snow come down from heaven and water the earth, making it bring forth and bud, so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but accomplish that which I please. When God's word comes on the earth people repent; every one of us is here because at some point we heard it.

Ye shall go out with joy, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands. The seed that was the word has become a tree, and that is us. Instead of the thorn, wicked brothers and sisters, shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier the myrtle, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
Everyone that thirsts is called to the waters, and he that has no money is told to come, buy, and eat wine and milk without money and without price. The invitation is free.

He asks why they spend money for that which is not bread and their labour for that which does not satisfy. They are told to hearken and eat that which is good, and let the soul delight itself in fatness.
If they incline their ear and come, their soul will live, and He will make an everlasting covenant with them, even the sure mercies of David.

David is given for a witness to the people, a leader and a commander. A nation not known will be called, and nations that did not know her will run to her because of the Most High, who has glorified her.

Seek the Most High while He may be found, call upon Him while He is near. The wicked is to forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts, and return to the Most High, who will have mercy and abundantly pardon.
His thoughts are not our thoughts, and His ways are not our ways. As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are His ways and His thoughts higher than ours.

As the rain and snow come down from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, causing it to bring forth seed and bread, so His word does not return to Him void but accomplishes what He pleases.
His people will go out with joy and be led forth with peace; the mountains and hills will break forth into singing and the trees of the field will clap their hands.
Instead of the thorn will come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier the myrtle tree, and this will be to the Most High for a name and an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.
